cases.name: Cortney Lyn Clayton
cases.about: She was a student at Oliver Elementary School.
cases.narrative: On 3/26/1989, her skull was found by hunters approximately 50 miles from her home. Additional portions of her skeleton, clothing she was wearing when she went missing, and additional unreleased evidence were found by Texas Rangers but due to decomposition, investigators were unable to determine a cause of death.
